name: neighbouraid-frontend

scripts.mobile:build: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios

_overrides_note: Transitive deps of build-time tooling (never shipped to the browser) that had open advisories with no released parent version picking up the fix. brace-expansion is scoped per-parent on purpose: the advisory covers <=1.1.17 and 3.0.0-5.0.8, so 1.1.18 and 5.0.9 are both clean — but a single global range cannot serve both, because legacy minimatch@3 needs the 1.x export shape while minimatch@10 needs 5.x. Forcing one globally breaks ESLint with 'expand is not a function'. Drop an entry once its parent depends on a clean version by itself.
